children: may consider the Sirius offshore gas project in Colombia as part of the production curve to be unveiled in its 2027-2031 business plan later this year, a company executive said on Wednesday.
Petrobras, which serves as operator in the project with a 44.4% stake along with Colombia's Ecopetrol
